scenarios.name: destroys-opponent-creature-its-controller-amasses
scenarios.why: The ETB destroys another target creature; its controller amasses Goblins X where X is that creature's power. Destroying the opponent's 2/2 makes that player create a 0/0 Army and put two +1/+1 counters on it. Because Azog's controller did not control the destroyed creature, no card is drawn.

scenarios.name: destroying-your-own-creature-draws-a-card
scenarios.why: If you controlled the destroyed creature, you draw a card in addition to amassing. Your own 2/2 dies, you create an Army and put two +1/+1 counters on it, and you draw.

scenarios.name: up-to-one-target-may-decline
scenarios.why: 'Up to one other target creature' is optional; with no other creature on the battlefield Azog simply resolves and no card is drawn.
